description: This file defines the Handler annotation used for marking classes that serve as handlers for other classes, providing metadata such as supported classes and order preferences.

classes.name: Handler
classes.description: Annotation used to specify classes that act as handlers for other classes, including supported class types and order of precedence.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Returns an array of Class objects that this handler supports.

methods.name: order
methods.description: Returns an integer indicating the relative order of this handler.
